name: net.mytierlist/tier-lists
title: MyTierList
description: Multilingual tier list maker: keyless consensus & PNG rendering, free API key for saved lists.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: The account this key acts as, and the key itself. Requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Public templates, newest or most popular first; or your own with mine=true. Public reads work without an API key; mine=true requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

limit.description: Maximum templates to return per page (1-50, default 24).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response nextCursor.

mine.description: When true, return only your own templates including private ones (requires API key; default false).

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

sort.description: Sort order: "recent" (newest edits first, default) or "popular" (most popular first).

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template in one language: tiers, the first 500 items, counts, consensus badges. Public read-only — works without an API key.

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

tools.name: list_template_items
tools.description: A page of a template’s items in position order; follow nextCursor. Public read-only — works without an API key.

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

cursor.description: Opaque item pagination cursor ("<position>|<itemId>") from the previous page nextCursor.

limit.description: Maximum items to return per page (1-500, default 200).

tools.name: get_template_consensus
tools.description: What people think: per item, the tier most chose, a mean score and how contested it is. Public read-only — works without an API key.

id.description: 12-character template ID to fetch community consensus for.

tools.name: query_tier_consensus
tools.description: Search public templates by topic and return their community consensus ranking grouped by tier (with item labels, scores, controversy, and MyTierList links) in one call. Public read-only — works without an API key.

query.description: Topic or template search query (1-60 chars, e.g. "pixar", "elden ring bosses").

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

limit.description: Maximum matching templates to return (1-5, default 1).

tools.name: render_text_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a shareable PNG tier list image from plain text tiers and items in one pass (no images, no API key, no account pollution). Cached by content hash with a minimal mytierlist.net watermark; pass inlineImage=true to also receive the PNG inline. Public read-only — works without an API key.

title.description: Tier list title shown on the rendered PNG (1-120 chars).

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

label.description: Tier row label shown on the chip (1-24 chars, e.g. "S", "A", "B").

color.description: Optional tier chip hex color (#rrggbb); defaults to an automatic tier color ramp.

items.description: Plain-text item labels placed in this tier (1-60 chars each; up to 30 total items across all tiers).

tiers.description: Ordered list of 1-10 tiers with their plain-text items (1-30 total items across all tiers).

style.description: Card visual style: "board" (clean board view, default) or "poster" (framed share card).

inlineImage.description: When true, also return the rendered PNG directly as a native MCP inline image block (default false).

tools.name: render_template_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a shareable PNG tier list image using an existing public template’s images and your tier placements (no API key, no saved result pollution). Cached by content hash with a minimal mytierlist.net watermark; pass inlineImage=true to also receive the PNG inline. Public read-only — works without an API key.

templateId.description: Public template 12-character ID or URL alias (e.g. "jzctdewr4hp9" or "pixar-films").

title.description: Optional custom title override shown on the PNG (1-120 chars; defaults to the template title).

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

tierId.description: Optional 6-character existing tier ID from get_template; omit when matching or naming by label.

label.description: Optional tier label (1-24 chars); matched to a template tier name if tierId is omitted, or used as a custom label.

color.description: Optional tier chip hex color (#rrggbb); defaults to the template tier color or ramp.

itemIds.description: Ordered array of 6-character item IDs from get_template or list_template_items placed in this tier.

tiers.description: Ordered list of 1-15 tiers with template itemIds placed in them (at least one itemId required).

style.description: Card visual style: "board" (clean board view, default) or "poster" (framed share card).

inlineImage.description: When true, also return the rendered PNG directly as a native MCP inline image block (default false).

tools.name: render_custom_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a PNG tier list mixing public https:// imageUrl items and plain text items (no API key). Failed or SSRF-blocked image URLs degrade gracefully into text tiles and are reported in failedImages. Returns the PNG directly as an inline MCP image (never hosted publicly in R2). Public read-only — works without an API key.

title.description: Tier list title shown on the rendered PNG (1-120 chars).

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

label.description: Tier row label shown on the chip (1-24 chars, e.g. "S", "A", "B").

color.description: Optional tier chip hex color (#rrggbb); defaults to an automatic tier color ramp.

anyOf.description: Plain-text item label (1-60 chars) rendered as a text tile.

label.description: Optional item label (1-60 chars); used as text tile if imageUrl is omitted or fails to load.

imageUrl.description: Optional public https:// image URL (up to 2048 chars); degrades to a text tile if fetch fails or is blocked.

anyOf.description: Custom item object with an optional public https:// imageUrl and/or text label (at least one required).

items.description: Items in this tier as plain strings or { label, imageUrl } objects (up to 30 total items and 20 imageUrls across all tiers).

tiers.description: Ordered list of 1-10 tiers containing mixed plain-text and/or public https:// imageUrl items (1-30 total items).

style.description: Card visual style: "board" (clean board view, default) or "poster" (framed share card).

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a template. Each item takes an imageId, an imageUrl to fetch, or a text-only label (auto-rendered into a PNG tile). Public unless visibility says private. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

draft.description: When true, save as an unpublished owner-only draft (default false).

name.description: Template title (up to 120 chars; required unless draft is true).

description.description: Optional template description or ranking context (up to 2000 chars).

imageSource.description: Optional one-line credit or source URL for template images (up to 300 chars).

tags.description: Optional discovery tags (normalized and deduplicated; up to 15 tags kept).

sourceLocale.description: Primary language/locale code of the template content (e.g. "en", "ja", "zh-Hans").

mode.description: Default ranking mode: "tier" (classic tier rows, default) or "top" (ordered top-N).

modeConfig.description: Optional mode-specific settings such as topLimit for top-ranking mode.

topLimit.description: Default slot cap in top-ranking mode (1-100, e.g. 5 or 10); null/omit ranks all items.

displayType.description: Item image crop/aspect mode: square, portrait, round, landscape, or no-crop (default "no-crop").

style.description: Optional default board visual style (layout, gap, corners, divider, align).

layout.description: Board layout: rows (chip on left), columns (chip on top), or stacked (full-width chip banner above items).

gap.description: Tile spacing in pixels between items and row edges (0, 4, or 8).

corners.description: Item tile corner style: square or rounded.

divider.description: Visual separator between tiers: none, line, or gap.

align.description: Tier label alignment inside a stacked chip: start, center, or end.

coverImageId.description: Optional uploaded image ID used as the template cover thumbnail.

id.description: Optional 6-character tier ID when updating an existing tier; omit to let the server assign one.

name.description: Tier label displayed on the chip (1-24 chars, e.g. "S", "A", "GOAT").

color.description: Tier chip background color in #rrggbb hex format (e.g. "#ff7f7f").

textColor.description: Optional tier chip text color in #rrggbb hex format; defaults to automatic contrast.

background.description: Optional tier row background color in #rrggbb hex format; omit to use the board surface.

fontSize.description: Optional tier chip text size in pixels (12-48, default 20).

tiers.description: Ordered list of 1-26 tier definitions (array order sets tier position).

id.description: Optional 6-character item ID when updating an existing template item; omit for new items.

imageId.description: Optional uploaded MyTierList image ID (mutually exclusive with imageUrl; omit both to auto-render a text tile from label).

label.description: Optional human-readable item label (up to 120 chars; null clears it).

imageUrl.description: Optional public http(s) image URL to fetch and store (max 100 per request; mutually exclusive with imageId).

items.description: Template items (up to 10000): each needs imageId, imageUrl (max 100/request), or a non-empty label for text-only tile generation (max 30/request).

tools.name: create_text_tier_list
tools.description: One-shot image-free tier list builder: renders crisp PNG text tiles for every item, creates the template, saves your ranked tier list, and returns direct share-card PNG and interactive edit URLs. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

title.description: Title for both the new template and saved tier list (1-120 chars).

locale.description: Language/locale code for localized names and rendering (default "en").

visibility.description: Visibility of the created template: "public" (default) or "private".

label.description: Tier label shown on the chip (1-24 chars, e.g. "S", "A", "B").

color.description: Optional tier chip hex color (#rrggbb); defaults to an automatic ember color ramp.

items.description: Plain-text item labels placed in this tier (1-120 chars each; up to 30 total items across tiers and unranked).

tiers.description: Ordered list of 1-10 tiers with their text items (1-30 total items across tiers and unranked).

unranked.description: Optional plain-text items included in the template tray without placing them in a tier (default []).

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Change one of your templates: name, description, tags, tiers, items (by imageId), visibility; draft:false publishes. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

draft.description: Set to false to publish an existing draft template (cannot unpublish).

name.description: Updated template title (up to 120 chars; omit to keep unchanged).

description.description: Updated template description (up to 2000 chars; null clears it; omit to keep unchanged).

imageSource.description: Updated image credit/source line (up to 300 chars; null clears it; omit to keep unchanged).

tags.description: Replacement list of discovery tags (replaces existing tags; omit to leave unchanged).

visibility.description: Updated visibility: "public" or "private" (omit to keep unchanged).

mode.description: Updated default ranking mode: "tier" or "top" (omit to keep unchanged).

modeConfig.description: Updated mode configuration (null clears it; omit to keep unchanged).

topLimit.description: Default slot cap in top-ranking mode (1-100, e.g. 5 or 10); null/omit ranks all items.

displayType.description: Updated item image crop/aspect mode (square, portrait, round, landscape, or no-crop).

style.description: Updated default board visual style (layout, gap, corners, divider, align).

layout.description: Board layout: rows (chip on left), columns (chip on top), or stacked (full-width chip banner above items).

gap.description: Tile spacing in pixels between items and row edges (0, 4, or 8).

corners.description: Item tile corner style: square or rounded.

divider.description: Visual separator between tiers: none, line, or gap.

align.description: Tier label alignment inside a stacked chip: start, center, or end.

coverImageId.description: Updated cover image ID (null clears it; omit to keep unchanged).

tiers.description: Replacement list of 1-26 tiers (include existing tier id to preserve it; omit to keep unchanged).

id.description: Optional 6-character tier ID when updating an existing tier; omit to let the server assign one.

name.description: Tier label displayed on the chip (1-24 chars, e.g. "S", "A", "GOAT").

color.description: Tier chip background color in #rrggbb hex format (e.g. "#ff7f7f").

textColor.description: Optional tier chip text color in #rrggbb hex format; defaults to automatic contrast.

background.description: Optional tier row background color in #rrggbb hex format; omit to use the board surface.

fontSize.description: Optional tier chip text size in pixels (12-48, default 20).

items.description: Replacement list of template items by imageId (include existing item id to preserve it; omit to keep unchanged).

id.description: Optional 6-character item ID when updating an existing template item; omit for new items.

imageId.description: Uploaded MyTierList image ID (8-32 lowercase Crockford base32 characters).

label.description: Optional human-readable item label (up to 120 chars; null clears it).

tools.name: put_template_translations
tools.description: Official names for items in other languages (kept over machine translation, never overwritten by the job), and the title and description per locale (kept until the source text changes). Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

id.description: 12-character ID of the template you own.

locales.description: Map of target locale code to an object mapping 6-char item ID -> translated label (max 200 chars; source locale is skipped).

fields.description: Map of target locale code to translated template title and/or description (source locale is skipped).

name.description: Translated template title for this locale (1-120 chars).

description.description: Translated template description for this locale (1-2000 chars).

tools.name: fork_template
tools.description: Copy a template you can read into one of your own. Private unless visibility says public. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

id.description: 12-character ID of the readable template to fork.

name.description: Optional title for the forked copy (1-120 chars; defaults to the source title).

visibility.description: Visibility of the forked template: "private" (default) or "public".

includeRemoved.description: When true, also restore soft-deleted items from the source template (default false).

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: Saved lists, newest first: public ones, optionally for one template; or your own with mine=true. Public reads work without an API key; mine=true requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

templateId.description: Optional 12-character template ID to filter saved lists to a single template.

mine.description: When true, return only your own saved lists including drafts (requires API key; default false).

limit.description: Maximum saved lists to return per page (1-50, default 24).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response nextCursor.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: One saved list: its tiers as they were, which item went where, the image behind each item, and the share-card URLs. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: get_result_image
tools.description: The share-card URL for a saved list, and whether the PNG is already cached. orientation=landscape|portrait, style=board|poster (board is the default: the page's own board), plus the board fields (layout/gap/corners/divider/align). Does not draw. Public read-only — works without an API key.

style.description: Share-card visual style: "board" (clean board view, default) or "poster" (framed share card).

gap.description: Optional tile spacing override in pixels (0, 4, or 8).

corners.description: Optional tile corner style override: "square" or "rounded".

align.description: Optional stacked chip label alignment override: "start", "center", or "end".

tools.name: create_result
tools.description: Save a list for a template: which item goes in which tier. With id, update your own. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

id.description: Optional 12-character result ID to update your own existing list; omit to create a new saved list.

templateId.description: 12-character ID of the template being ranked.

title.description: Optional custom title for this saved ranking (up to 120 chars).

sourceLocale.description: Language/locale code of the title and notes (e.g. "en", "ja", "zh-Hans").

v.description: Schema version for classic tier-list layout (must be 1).

name.description: Tier label displayed on the chip (1-24 chars).

color.description: Tier chip background color in #rrggbb hex format.

textColor.description: Optional tier chip text color in #rrggbb hex format.

background.description: Optional tier row background color in #rrggbb hex format.

fontSize.description: Optional tier chip font size in pixels (12-48, default 20).

position.description: Zero-based display order index of this tier (0-63).

tiers.description: Full snapshot of 1-26 tier definitions for this saved list.

assignments.description: Map from 6-char tier ID to ordered array of 6-char item IDs placed in that tier.

unassigned.description: Ordered array of 6-char item IDs left unranked in the tray.

style.description: Optional board visual style snapshot; omit to inherit the template style.

layout.description: Board layout: rows (chip on left), columns (chip on top), or stacked (full-width chip banner above items).

gap.description: Tile spacing in pixels between items and row edges (0, 4, or 8).

corners.description: Item tile corner style: square or rounded.

divider.description: Visual separator between tiers: none, line, or gap.

align.description: Tier label alignment inside a stacked chip: start, center, or end.

v.description: Schema version for top-N ordered ranking layout (must be 2).

kind.description: Layout discriminator for top-N mode (must be "top").

ranking.description: Ordered array of 6-char item IDs from #1 (index 0) onward.

unassigned.description: Ordered array of 6-char item IDs left unranked.

limit.description: Optional top-N slot cap (1-100, e.g. 5, 10, 20); null/omit means no cap.

style.description: Optional board visual style snapshot; omit to inherit the template style.

layout.description: Board layout: rows (chip on left), columns (chip on top), or stacked (full-width chip banner above items).

gap.description: Tile spacing in pixels between items and row edges (0, 4, or 8).

corners.description: Item tile corner style: square or rounded.

divider.description: Visual separator between tiers: none, line, or gap.

align.description: Tier label alignment inside a stacked chip: start, center, or end.

layout.description: Full ranking snapshot: either a v1 tier-row layout or a v2 top-N ordered layout.

body.description: Optional overall commentary/prose for the tier list (up to 5000 chars).

notes.description: Optional map of 6-char item ID to per-item explanation note (up to 500 chars each).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: What your keys did over the last days, per day and operation. Requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

days.description: Number of trailing days of API usage to aggregate (1-90, default 30).
